# House rules for the flat
Hi both, a few things so we don't fight:
- Rent is $1,800 a month, split three ways, due on the 1st.
- No smoking inside. Balcony is fine.
- Guests can stay max 3 nights in a row unless everyone agrees.
- If you break something, you pay to fix it.
If you want to move out, give the others **30 days' notice** and help find someone for your room.
Questions? Email me at sam@flatmail.com or check https://example.com/rules.
legal version
# Rules Governing the Flat
The Parties agree that the following matters shall be addressed in good faith without further dispute:
- The monthly rent shall be $1,800, payable in three (3) equal installments, on the first (1st) day of each month.
- Smoking is prohibited within the Building. Smoking is permitted on the balcony.
- Guests shall not stay more than three (3) consecutive nights in any single stay.
- If the User causes damage to any item, the User shall pay for its repair.
If the Tenant wishes to vacate the Premises, the Tenant shall give the other Tenant **thirty (30) days' notice**
and assist in finding a replacement tenant. Questions may be directed to the Tenant at sam@flatmail.com or
referred to https://example.com/rules.
